subject: Post-call: platform integration recap — embeddings, rerank, function-calls
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@medaihealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: platform integration recap — embeddings, rerank, function-calls

Hi Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and the concrete next steps so we stay aligned.

Pain points you called out:
- Current search/ranking on clinical notes is noisy: too many false positives, clinicians want higher precision on top-3 results.
- Tail latency on multi-section document reranks is inconsistent (spikes during peak hours).
- Security/compliance: HIPAA controls, customer-managed keys, and audit logs are required for pilot.

Goals we agreed on:
- Improve top-k precision for clinician searches using embeddings + rerank (target: +15–20% precision at top-3).
- Keep end-to-end 95th pct latency under 200ms for single-record inference in steady state.
- Run a 2-week pilot with redwood-hosted inference and on-prem-ready config for later migration.

Product fit summary / integration notes:
- Embeddings: we recommend a dense-embedding pipeline (512d default) to start, with Faiss-based nearest-neighbor on your vector store.
- Rerank: two-stage approach — vector recall -> cross-encoder rerank. We can host the cross-encoder on Redwood Dedicated or provide a low-latency variant.
- Function calling & structured output: use function-call schema to return structured match objects (id, score, snippet, canonical_reason) to avoid brittle parsing in your UI.
- Streaming: streaming responses for reranking stages will enable progressive UI updates; our SDK supports chunked streaming and partial structured outputs.
- SDK changes: you'll need to add a small streaming handler; Marcus will provide a lightweight patch that adds websocket fallback + structured schema serializer.

Immediate next steps (action owners):
1) Lauren: send a draft SOW + integration outline (attached) by EOD.
2) Alex: share a representative sample corpus (anonymized) + expected QPS for sizing.
3) Marcus: propose model/config options and a POC timeline by tomorrow.
4) Alex/security@medaihealth.com: complete the brief security checklist; we can follow with SOC2 artifacts after the NDA.

Attachments included: medai_integration_outline.pdf (high-level SOW), sow_template_medai_v1.docx (editable).

If anything above is off, say so — otherwise I'll treat this as the mutual action plan and push the SOW.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@medaihealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medaihealth.com
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: platform integration recap — embeddings, rerank, function-calls

Lauren — thanks for the detailed recap, this is helpful and accurate. A few clarifications from our side:

- Sample corpus: we'll extract ~5k de-identified clinical notes (JSONL) and a small ground-truth set for evaluation; will aim to deliver by Thu.
- QPS: cold-start expectation ~10 qps, peak ~60 qps during business hours. Latency SLA is important — we'll want benchmarks on 95th/99th percentiles during the pilot.
- Embedding dim: are you recommending 512 vs 768? Cost/latency trade-offs are relevant here.
- Security: our infosec team needs to see the SOC2 report and your KMS integration details before we move data into any hosted environment. Can you provision those docs?

Also, hook for internal ops: who will be our day-to-day technical contact for the POC? Marcus?

— Alex
Alex Turner
Head of ML Systems, MedAI Health
alex.turner@medaihealth.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@medaihealth.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Mar 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: platform integration recap — embeddings, rerank, function-calls

Alex — good questions. Quick technical notes and a proposed POC approach: 

1) Embedding dimension: start with 512 for the pilot to keep memory and latencies down; if evaluation shows quality loss we can move to 768 for the rerank step (hybrid config: 512 for retrieval, 768 for cross-encoder inputs).

2) Model recommendations: for retrieval embeddings we suggest a dense, quantized 8-bit candidate (Open model X-embed-512-q8). For the cross-encoder rerank, a distilled cross-encoder hosted on Dedicated is the best tradeoff. We can also provide a 4-bit quantized variant for cost-sensitive runs.

3) Latency sizing: given your QPS numbers, a small Dedicated pool of 2xA100-equivalent nodes with continuous batching should meet 95th <200ms for single-record rerank in our estimates. We'll run load tests against your sample corpus and adjust.

4) SDK/engineering: attached is a branch (redwood-sdk-streaming-patch.diff) that adds a streaming schema serializer and websocket fallback to the client. Tessa will own the client-side guidance docs for integration.

Proposed POC timeline (2 weeks):
- Day 0–2: NDA + SOW + sample data handed off.
- Day 3–7: baseline ingest, retrieval + embedding evaluation, model tuning.
- Day 8–12: integrate cross-encoder rerank + streaming, run end-to-end benchmarks.
- Day 13–14: results presentation and next-step options (Dedicated commit vs Private deployment).

I'm happy to be the technical owner for the POC and will be available for daily async syncs.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Alex / team — great, thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming next items: 

- I'll send a short SOW and a DocuSign link for the NDA by noon PST. (Link included in related_links.)
- Marcus will kick off the SDK patch and a small test harness; Marcus/Tessa will send instructions for ingest and a minimal Faiss config.
- Please upload the anonymized sample corpus to the temporary S3 bucket we shared in the HubSpot record; notify us once it's there.
- Security: we'll attach SOC2 artifacts and KMS integration docs in a secure folder once the NDA is signed.

If all good, I'll schedule the kickoff call for next Wednesday, Apr 7, 09:00 AM PT — tentative unless that conflicts.

Thanks everyone — excited to get this moving.

Lauren Bishop
